Legal information

Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 10, 2026

App: Noktaları Sırala

Developer and data controller: Alperen Şahin

At a glance

Noktaları Sırala does not display ads, track users, or send data to a developer-operated analytics or advertising server. Game preferences and single-player progress are stored on the device. Online features use Apple Game Center.

Information stored on the device

Language selection, unlocked stages, selected stage, best times, and a local copy of the online rating are stored in the app's space on the device. This information is not transmitted to a server operated by the developer. Deleting the app also removes this locally stored information.

Game Center and gameplay data

The app checks Game Center authentication status when it opens. Player authentication, automatic matchmaking, online duels, and leaderboards use Apple Game Center. The app may read the Game Center display name and player identifier; Apple may process scores, match information, and gameplay data. Necessary messages such as the stage/game layout, progress, and finish time are transmitted between matched devices through Game Center. This temporary match data is not stored on a developer-operated server.

The developer does not operate a separate user-account system or gameplay database, does not sell Game Center data, and does not use it for advertising. Apple's processing is governed by its own Privacy Policy and Game Center terms.

Apple Privacy Policy

Tracking, advertising, and third-party analytics

The app contains no advertising SDK, third-party analytics SDK, or cross-app tracking technology. Personal data is not shared with advertisers.

Children's privacy

The app does not provide chat or user-generated-content features. App Store age ratings may vary by country or region. The developer does not request contact information directly from children. Game Center use is subject to Apple's account, family, and age-appropriateness controls.

Choices and deletion

Deleting the app removes locally stored game data. Temporary match data is not saved to a permanent server operated by the developer. You can stop Game Center access by signing out under Settings → Game Center. The developer does not determine Apple's retention period and cannot directly delete data held by Apple.

Apple Account data access or deletion requests can be managed at Apple Data and Privacy or through Apple Support.

Changes to this policy

If the app's data practices change, this page and its effective date will be updated. Important changes may also be noted in the description of a new app version.

Contact

For privacy questions, email alperen9393@hotmail.com. You may also open a GitHub support request . A GitHub account is required and requests may be public. Do not include passwords, phone numbers, or other sensitive information.
